verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for an online registered-agent and business-filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of any API: the site returned a Cloudflare challenge to the probe, and the one community comment concerns SEO, not API access. With no evidence of an API, let alone parity with the UI, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
